posts.hook: Cash flow forecasting is now CFOs' top liquidity risk for 2026, ahead of market volatility.
posts.key_stat: 38% of CFOs and treasurers rank forecasting first. Market volatility ranks second, at 35%.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card leading with 38%, contrasting forecasting versus 35% market volatility to frame the inward shift in CFO risk focus.
